data.notes: Only one June 2027 contemporary music event surfaced with primary confirmation so far; major Tbilisi club and festival calendars have not yet published confirmed June 2027 programs.

events.title: Bryan Adams — Roll With The Punches Tour
events.summary: Bryan Adams brings the Roll With The Punches tour to Rustavi International Motorpark, listed by the artist as the Tbilisi/Georgia date on June 17, 2027. The ticketing page confirms the same date, 19:00 start time, and venue.
